messages:
Lina (Product): quick thread — packing final asks for tomorrow's pricing workshop. need decisions on: trial soft caps, reserve-slot amortization, and whether priority-routing bundles with support.
Ravi (Finance): preference: keep pricing primitives simple. two axes: commit depth (monthly/annual) and reserved concurrency (slots). discounts: 0% / 15% for monthly/annual. reserved slots priced as flat monthly fee + per-hour usage.
Cass (Sales): field notes: mid-market customers want a small guaranteed lane and some burst runway during big launches. they hate token math on decks. suggest we show 3 sample profiles (starter, growth, enterprise) with worked $ examples.
Elena (Legal): need to limit forgiveness language. suggestion: "launch grace" = first 30 days post-provisioning, overages billed at list and eligible for customer-initiated review within 60 days. no automatic refunds. also include 30-day downsize notice for reserved slots on multi-month commits.
Marco (Eng): two engineering constraints: (1) reserved slots require pre-provisioned pools so we can hit latency SLOs; (2) burst credits are a billing abstraction only unless customer purchases dedicated burst slots. operational cost ~ 0.6 reserved GPU-hour per active slot/hour.
Ravi (Finance): propose pricing block: $300/slot/month min + $0.20/slot-GPU-hour usage. example: 2 slots => $600/mo + usage. this covers reserved pool amortization.
Jules (Support): bundling note: customers expect 24/7 on Performance tier. if we bundle priority-routing + 24/7, support costs increase. suggest optional add-on: "Priority Care" $2k/mo or included at Performance.
Cass (Sales): sample profiles please include exact numbers: e.g., Growth = quarterly commit $18k/mo, includes 1 slot + 50M burst tokens. Enterprise = annual $150k ARR + 5 slots. that helps close.
Lina (Product): proposal: publish 3 tiers (Starter, Growth, Enterprise). Starter = metered, no reserved slots, trial softcap 5M tokens. Growth = includes 1 slot + 100M burst credits, quarterly/annual only. Enterprise = custom sizing, SLA, 24/7 included. Priority-routing sold per-slot.
Elena (Legal): Term Sheet items: explicit region gating (US first, EU in next quarter), termination/downsizing clause, billing review window, and SLA credit table.
Marco (Eng): rollout plan: priority-routing GA in us-east. EU + APAC follow-on. add feature flagging and perf tests in the release checklist.
BillingBot: billing-config v2.8 deployed to staging at 2026-03-21T15:02:10Z (CI 4871).
Ravi (Finance): gating metrics before public launch: 2 pilots on Growth/Enterprise covering >= $60k ARR; billing end-to-end tests green; projected P&L impact < 2.5% margin hit from reserved pools.
Cass (Sales): I'm lining up Pilot with NodeWave and Brightly — pushing for Growth quarterly to avoid year-long legal cycles.
Jules (Support): we'll need runbooks for priority incidents on reserved slots; add to onboarding checklist.
Lina (Product): decision for tomorrow: accept three-tier model, price slots as $300/mo + usage, include 30-day launch grace (billing at list with review window), and make Priority-routing a per-slot add-on. I'll update the deck and share by 16:00. objections?
Elena (Legal): none from me; will upload redlines to term sheet by 5pm.
Ravi (Finance): add one worked example in deck showing monthly bill for Growth with 1 slot + 120M tokens.
Cass (Sales): 👍 will prep customer facing one-pager after deck.
Lina (Product): thanks — ping me if anything breaks.
